meaning.en: To retire or step back boldly at the height of one's success or in the midst of turbulence.
meaning.zh: 在顺利或形势急剧变化时勇敢地隐退，比喻见好就收、及时抽身。

examples.zh: 他在事业巅峰时急流勇退，让许多人意外。
examples.en: He stepped down at the peak of his career, surprising many.

examples.zh: 这位老将选择急流勇退，把位置让给年轻人。
examples.en: The veteran chose to bow out and make way for the young.

meaning.en: To have a life full of setbacks and misfortune.
meaning.zh: 指命运坎坷，一生多遭挫折。

examples.zh: 这位作家命途多舛，晚年才获得认可。
examples.en: The writer's life was dogged by misfortune; recognition came only late.

examples.zh: 她命途多舛，却始终不向命运低头。
examples.en: Though her fate was hard, she never bowed to it.

story.en: In his Preface to the Pavilion of Prince Teng, Wang Bo laments 'the times are not even, one's destiny is full of setbacks' (时运不齐，命途多舛).
story.zh: 王勃《滕王阁序》：“时运不齐，命途多舛。冯唐易老，李广难封。”

meaning.en: To attack in every direction at once; to take on many fronts or opponents simultaneously.
meaning.zh: 向四面八方同时出击，也比喻同时在多个方面行动或树敌。

examples.zh: 这家公司四面出击，同时进入三个新市场。
examples.en: The company is attacking on all fronts, entering three new markets at once.

examples.zh: 他不分轻重，四面出击，最后精疲力竭。
examples.en: He fought on every front without priorities and ended up exhausted.

usage.en: Predicate; can be neutral or mildly critical.

meaning.en: Literature should be a vehicle for moral and philosophical principles.
meaning.zh: 文章是用来阐明和传播道理（道德、思想）的。

equivalents: writing as a vehicle for the Way

examples.zh: 他主张文以载道，反对为写而写。
examples.en: He holds that writing should carry a message, and opposes writing for its own sake.

examples.zh: “文以载道”是古代文学理论的重要观点。
examples.en: 'Writing conveys the Way' is a key idea in classical literary theory.

story.en: Zhou Dunyi of the Song dynasty wrote that writing is what carries the Way (文所以载道也), establishing the slogan for Neo-Confucian literary thought.
story.zh: 周敦颐《通书》：“文所以载道也。”

meaning.en: To cause one's own downfall through one's own actions.
meaning.zh: 自己的行为使自己走向灭亡。

examples.zh: 一意孤行只会自取灭亡。
examples.en: Acting wilfully will only bring about your own ruin.

examples.zh: 这家公司造假，无异于自取灭亡。
examples.en: Faking the accounts was tantamount to digging the firm's own grave.

meaning.en: Methods and principles for keeping healthy and living long.
meaning.zh: 保养身体、延年益寿的方法和道理。

examples.zh: 早睡早起是最简单的养生之道。
examples.en: Going to bed and rising early is the simplest way to stay healthy.

examples.zh: 爷爷说，知足常乐才是养生之道。
examples.en: Grandpa says contentment is the real secret of long life.

usage.en: Noun phrase; common in health talk.
usage.zh: 名词性短语，常见于养生话题。

meaning.en: To dangle official posts and rewards to win people over.
meaning.zh: 用许诺官职和好处来拉拢人心。

examples.zh: 竞选时他到处封官许愿，拉拢人心。
examples.en: During the campaign he dangled jobs everywhere to win supporters.

examples.zh: 靠封官许愿换来的忠诚是靠不住的。
examples.en: Loyalty bought with promised posts cannot be relied on.

meaning.en: To be blamed or punished whatever one does.
meaning.zh: 一动就受到责备或惩处，形容处境困难。

examples.zh: 在那个严苛的环境里，员工动辄得咎。
examples.en: In that harsh environment, staff were blamed whatever they did.

examples.zh: 新媳妇初到婆家，觉得动辄得咎。
examples.en: The new bride felt she could do nothing right in her in-laws' house.

story.en: Han Yu, describing a scholar's frustrations: 'Stumbling forward and back, whatever he does he is blamed' (跋前踬后，动辄得咎).
story.zh: 韩愈《进学解》：“跋前踬后，动辄得咎。”

meaning.en: To be famous everywhere.
meaning.zh: 名声传遍天下。

examples.zh: 景德镇的瓷器名扬四海。
examples.en: Jingdezhen porcelain is famous the world over.

examples.zh: 他靠一部电影名扬四海。
examples.en: One film made his name known across the world.

meaning.en: Beyond the highest heavens; completely forgotten or cast aside.
meaning.zh: 九重天外，比喻极高极远的地方，常指完全忘记。

examples.zh: 一见到好吃的，减肥的事全被他抛到九霄云外。
examples.en: At the sight of good food he threw his diet to the winds.

examples.zh: 他的思绪早已飘到了九霄云外。
examples.en: His thoughts had drifted off to the far horizon.

usage.en: Often 抛到/飞到九霄云外.

meaning.en: To deceive the public to gain an undeserved reputation.
meaning.zh: 欺骗世人，窃取名誉。

examples.zh: 他靠抄袭欺世盗名，终被揭穿。
examples.en: He won his fame by plagiarism and was finally exposed.

examples.zh: 这位大师不过是欺世盗名之徒。
examples.en: This so-called master is nothing but a charlatan.

meaning.en: To refuse to give up even a small piece of land or ground.
meaning.zh: 一点土地也不肯让出，形容坚决捍卫立场或利益。

examples.zh: 在领土问题上，我们寸土不让。
examples.en: On territorial matters we will not yield an inch.

examples.zh: 双方在谈判中寸土不让，僵持不下。
examples.en: Neither side would give an inch, and the talks stalled.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，用于政治、谈判。

meaning.en: A life of indulgence in pleasure: entertainment, sensuality, hunting and horses.
meaning.zh: 指寻欢作乐、骄奢淫逸的生活。

examples.zh: 他整日沉迷于声色犬马，荒废了学业。
examples.en: He spent his days in debauchery and neglected his studies.

examples.zh: 富二代的声色犬马生活令人侧目。
examples.en: The heir's fast living raised eyebrows.

usage.en: Often 沉迷/沉溺于声色犬马.

meaning.en: An honorific title for Confucius: the Supreme Sage and First Teacher.
meaning.zh: 对孔子的尊称。

equivalents: the Supreme Sage and First Teacher

examples.zh: 孔子被尊为至圣先师。
examples.en: Confucius is revered as the Supreme Sage and First Teacher.

examples.zh: 教师节与纪念至圣先师有着渊源。
examples.en: Teachers' Day has links to commemorating the Supreme Sage and First Teacher.

meaning.en: The longer things drag on, the more things can go wrong.
meaning.zh: 时间一长，事情可能发生变化，出现麻烦。

examples.zh: 这事得赶紧办，免得夜长梦多。
examples.en: We must settle this quickly, before something goes wrong.

examples.zh: 合同早点签，夜长梦多。
examples.en: Sign the contract soon; delay only invites trouble.

usage.en: Often 免得/以免夜长梦多.

meaning.en: Extremely difficult; all kinds of difficulty.
meaning.zh: 形容困难极多、极大。

examples.zh: 千难万难，也要把这件事做成。
examples.en: However hard it is, we must see this through.

examples.zh: 创业之初千难万难，他都挺了过来。
examples.en: The start-up years were fraught with difficulty, but he pulled through.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial; often 千难万难，也要….

meaning.en: Chivalrous and righteous in spirit, always ready to help others.
meaning.zh: 形容有侠义精神，见义勇为，乐于助人。

examples.zh: 他侠肝义胆，见到不平事总要出手。
examples.en: He is chivalrous and always steps in against injustice.

examples.zh: 这位侠肝义胆的老人救了落水儿童。
examples.en: The brave, righteous old man rescued the child who had fallen into the water.

meaning.en: To gallop freely in every direction; to act with unrestrained boldness.
meaning.zh: 指骑马奔驰，无拘无束；也比喻在某一领域大展身手。

examples.zh: 骑兵在草原上纵横驰骋。
examples.en: The cavalry galloped freely across the grassland.

examples.zh: 他在商界纵横驰骋数十年。
examples.en: He dominated the business world for decades.

meaning.en: To enforce the law firmly and impartially, unmoved like a mountain.
meaning.zh: 执行法律像山一样坚定不动摇，公正严明。

equivalents: enforce the law without fear or favour

examples.zh: 包拯执法如山，不畏权贵。
examples.en: Bao Zheng enforced the law like a rock, unafraid of the powerful.

examples.zh: 法官执法如山，赢得了群众的信任。
examples.en: The judge upheld the law firmly and won public trust.

usage.en: Predicate; in praise of officials, judges, police.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，赞法官、执法者。

meaning.en: Laden with grave sins and wrongdoing.
meaning.zh: 罪恶很深、很重。

examples.zh: 他自知罪孽深重，主动投案自首。
examples.en: Knowing his crimes were grave, he gave himself up.

examples.zh: 这个罪孽深重的集团终于被捣毁。
examples.en: The gang, guilty of terrible crimes, was finally smashed.

meaning.en: A completely clear sky without a single cloud.
meaning.zh: 天空晴朗，没有一片云。

equivalents: not a cloud in the sky

examples.zh: 今天万里无云，适合出游。
examples.en: The sky is cloudless today, ideal for an outing.

examples.zh: 秋日的天空万里无云，蓝得透亮。
examples.en: The autumn sky was cloudless and brilliantly blue.

meaning.en: To come in high spirits, full of enthusiasm.
meaning.zh: 趁着兴致来到。常与“败兴而归”“兴尽而返”对举。

examples.zh: 他乘兴而来，却吃了闭门羹。
examples.en: He came full of enthusiasm only to find the door shut.

examples.zh: 乘兴而来，败兴而归，这趟旅行真扫兴。
examples.en: We came in high spirits and left deflated; what a letdown of a trip.

story.en: Wang Huizhi, on a snowy night, sailed to visit Dai Kui but turned back at his door: 'I went on a whim and came back when the whim was spent' (吾本乘兴而行，兴尽而返).
story.zh: 《世说新语》：“吾本乘兴而行，兴尽而返，何必见戴？”

usage.en: Often paired with 败兴而归 / 兴尽而返.
usage.zh: 常与“败兴而归”“兴尽而返”连用。
